# DevFlow

> DevFlow is a modern cloud deployment platform for building, deploying, and scaling backend microservices and full-stack MERN web applications.

## Key Sections
- [Platform Overview](https://devflow.live/#hero): Introduction to DevFlow's next-generation infrastructure.
- [Core Features](https://devflow.live/#features): Detailed specifications for edge deployments, security, and observability.
- [Customer Case Studies](https://devflow.live/#testimonials): Engineering success stories and performance benchmarks.
- [Enterprise Contact](https://devflow.live/#contact): Connect with solutions architects for dedicated clusters.

## Features
- [Instant Edge Deployment](https://devflow.live/#features): Distributed multi-region edge deployment network.
- [Automated TLS & Security](https://devflow.live/#features): Zero-config SSL certificates and DDoS protection.
- [Real-Time Telemetry](https://devflow.live/#features): End-to-end tracing and OpenTelemetry logs.
